summary: Public projects created on 3 August 2026: 2 repos and 1 dataset.
intro: Agent tooling covered standing instructions for AI agents and a Claude Code plugin for Israeli phonebook entries in Google Contacts. A training dataset classified household and small business goods hierarchically, with handling attributes on each class.

projects.name: Agent Habits
projects.description: Standing instructions for AI agents: habits (rules) and SOPs (procedures), one markdown file each, with a library of example habits to adopt and a small generated system-prompt block.

projects.name: Israel Phonebook Manager
projects.description: Claude Code plugin for creating and maintaining Israeli phonebook entries in Google Contacts — counter vs call-centre hours, Shabbat and chag closures, seasonal timetables, star and 1-800 numbers...

projects.name: Homegoods Taxonomy
projects.description: A hierarchical classification of the physical goods in an ordinary home or small business, with a physical handling attribute layer attached to every class.
